title: Refraction at Plane Surfaces — Quick Quiz

questions.q: For total internal reflection to occur, light must travel from:
options: Optically rarer to optically denser medium
Optically denser to optically rarer medium
questions.explanation: TIR strictly requires light to travel from a denser medium to a rarer medium so that the angle of refraction can reach 90°.

questions.q: The formula for the lateral shift 'x' produced by a parallel slab of thickness 't' is:
questions.explanation: By geometric derivation in right triangles ΔBCE and ΔBCF, x = t * sin(i - r) / cos(r).

questions.q: If the refractive index of glass is 1.5, what is its critical angle in air?
The Numerical Aperture (NA) of an optical fiber with core μ1 and cladding μ2 is:
questions.explanation: NA = sin(θa) = √(μ1² - μ2²), representing the light gathering capability of the fiber.
